releaseNotes:
• 🎯 Multi-Selection Engine: Hold / long-press any video to select multiple items with instant checkmarks and Select All / Deselect All controls
• 📁 Move & Copy to Folder + Create New Folder: Easily move or copy selected videos into existing folders or create brand new folders on device storage with one-tap Paste Here
• 🗑️ Batch Actions Toolbar: Permanent delete, multi-video sharing, batch move into Private Vault (PIN locker), Favorite All, and combined storage properties calculation
• 🔲 Enhanced Grid & List View: Modern card layout with responsive spacing, high-resolution thumbnail caching, duration badges, and smooth layout switching
• ⚡ Seamless GitHub Auto-Updater: Automatic background check, direct download notification, and one-tap Package Installer integration
